title: acmella alba
intro: Acmella alba, commonly known as toothache plant or Parlor Plant, is a species of flowering plant in the sunflower family. This plant is known for its ability to numb the pain and reduce inflammation, making it a popular natural remedy for toothaches, headaches, and other minor ailments. The health benefits of Acmella alba include its anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties, which can help to reduce pain and swelling. The therapeutic actions of this plant can be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and saponins, which work together to provide relief from pain and discomfort.
